Method of Attack: Improper Input Validation leading to code execution, denial of service or information disclosure
DLL hijacking (binary planting or DLL preloading attack) leading to escalation of privileges through code execution
Discoverer: David Yesland of Rhino Security Labs
Kushal Arvind Shah of Fortinet's FortiGuard Labs
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with NVIDIA GeForce Experience versions prior to 3.19
